payload.prompt: We have discovered errors in the general ledger for January and February 2026. Review all vouchers and find the 4 errors: a posting to the wrong account (account 6540 used instead of 6860, amount 4800 NOK), a duplicate voucher (account 6500, amount 1050 NOK), a missing VAT line (account 7000, amount excl. 6750 NOK missing VAT on account 2710), and an incorrect amount (account 6500, 15700 NOK posted instead of 8100 NOK). Correct all errors with appropriate correction vouchers.

payload.goal: Review January and February 2026 vouchers, identify the 4 specified ledger errors, and correct them with appropriate correction vouchers.
likely_resources: Voucher details with account lines and amounts
success_checks: A voucher with account 6540 amount 4800 NOK is corrected so net effect moves cost to account 6860
The duplicate voucher on account 6500 amount 1050 NOK is fully reversed
The voucher on account 7000 amount 6750 NOK excl. VAT has a correction adding missing VAT to account 2710
The incorrect posting on account 6500 for 15700 NOK is corrected to intended amount 8100 NOK
All correction vouchers are dated appropriately within the correction process and balance to zero per voucher
Ledger impact after corrections matches the intended final balances for the affected accounts
risk_notes: Original voucher numbers are not provided; matching must rely on period, account, and amount and may be ambiguous if multiple similar vouchers exist
VAT rate is not explicitly stated; standard Norwegian VAT is likely 25%, implying missing VAT of 1687.50 NOK on 6750 NOK excl. VAT, but this should be verified
Correction date is not specified; posting in original period may be blocked if periods are closed
Need to confirm whether corrections should use reversal vouchers or manual adjustment vouchers per accounting policy
Duplicate voucher identification may require checking counterpart accounts and dates to avoid reversing a legitimate separate transaction

line_items.description: Add missing VAT line for account 7000 posting 6750 NOK excl. VAT to account 2710

Create correction voucher: credit account 6540 for 4800 NOK and debit account 6860 for 4800 NOK, referencing original voucher
Inspect vouchers to find the duplicate entry on account 6500 for 1050 NOK and confirm it is a true duplicate by matching date, text, and counterpart lines
Create reversal voucher for the duplicate voucher or post an equal and opposite correction voucher referencing the original voucher number

Calculate missing VAT, likely 1687.50 NOK at 25%, and create correction voucher adding VAT to account 2710 with balancing entry to the original counterpart/VAT settlement logic as required
Inspect vouchers to find the account 6500 posting of 15700 NOK that should have been 8100 NOK
Create correction voucher reducing the expense by 7600 NOK on account 6500 with balancing entry to the original counterpart account, referencing original voucher

rules: REQUIRES dateFrom and dateTo as query params. Without them you get 422.
Example: params={"dateFrom": "2026-01-01", "dateTo": "2026-12-31"}
Use a broad date range. For year-end: dateFrom=YYYY-01-01, dateTo=YYYY-12-31.
Optional filters: number, description.
These are QUERY PARAMS via the params field — NOT json_body.
Method is PUT, not POST.
date is a QUERY PARAMETER: PUT /ledger/voucher/{id}/:reverse?date=YYYY-MM-DD
Do NOT send date in the request body.
Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
